text.description_html:
Acorn PS3YP, Hand Painted Fall Colors Ceramic Cabinet Knob

The Fall Colors Ceramic Cabinet Knob features a hand painted oak acorn and leaf. This knob is great way to bring in woodland nature to any home. It is for light interior doors such as those found on accordion closets, cabinet doors, or furniture drawers. Made by Acorn Manufacturing, it is constructed from ceramic. It is 1-7/8" squared.

Features of the Fall Colors Ceramic Cabinet Knob:

  • Length: 1-7/8" square
  • Material: ceramic
  • Each design is hand painted on ceramic.
  • Package includes 1 knob and hardware for installation.

Sold Individually. Due to the hand painted nature of this product, the colors will vary slightly.
